convoys.title: Apex Transporte Company Convoy
convoys.notes:
Convoy note for today. Read this before you roll.

Keep a safe gap from the truck ahead. Stay in your lane and follow the lead driver. Use your indicators early. 

Wait for the leader before you leave the meetup point. Drive at the set speed limit. If you lose the convoy, tell us in chat right away.

See you on the road. 🚛
